text: Based on the provided tool outputs, approximately 0.5 hectares (ha) of native forest was lost on the property. This represents about 2.84% of the total asset area of 17.6 ha. The loss occurred in 2022 and was observed by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13). The European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 data corroborated that the area was indeed forested in 2020. The Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries' national forest cartography confirmed that the lost area was native forest, with no planted forest present.
